# Vendored Wallpaper Engine host and renderer

Source: https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine

Commit: 1d38c094a70ed8e573d99b504932c9aa058111b1

Host version: 1.3.1. Embedded WebWallGL version: 2.1.0 (see lib/webwallgl/.upstream.json).
